verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence documents a no-training policy, a training opt-out, or any contractual guarantee about model training on customer code. The hybrid deployment, where AI inference and storage run in the customer's own AWS account, is a data-residency control. That is adjacent to this story, not the capability itself, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
